mostWorthwhile.text: Turning toward the voice was the most worthwhile action: it showed hearing and movement working together in a recognizable situation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the cup felt least worthwhile because it was a straightforward preparation with little new information.

surprise.text: The final result connected the drink to the gut, blood and cells over time while breathing continued. That made the separate systems feel like parts of a working whole.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear purpose in the stated goal, though most were the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it explored a new question, but this chapter's predictable sequence felt like a natural ending.
